name: 1-1-1 (Put 1-1-1)
summary: The step-down from the 112: a long put debit spread plus a single naked short put, halving the tail exposure and most of the credit.

legs.strike_rule: put delta 0.25-0.30, completing the debit spread
put delta 0.05-0.10, >= 10% below spot - the NAKED financing put

max_profit: net credit (or debit-spread width minus debit) + debit-spread width x 100 at the lower spread strike
max_loss: UNDEFINED - 1 x $100 per point below the naked strike, to zero
breakevens: naked strike - (net credit + debit-spread max value) per share
when_to_use: INCLUDED FOR COMPLETENESS ONLY - NOT TRADEABLE AT LEVEL 3. The standard de-risked version of the 112 when the account cannot carry 2x naked notional, or when the trader wants the same skew harvest at half size.
entry_rules: BLOCKED: one uncovered short put; requires Alpaca options level 4.

LEVEL 3 SUBSTITUTE: replace the naked put with a put credit spread (4 legs total, inside the scope cap) or cash-secure it - cash securing needs strike x 100 in cash, which caps the underlying price at about $150 on a $50k account if nothing else is held.
If enabled at level 4: IV rank >= 35, naked strike delta <= 0.10, and total structure risk measured to zero <= 30% of equity.
management_rules: Take profit at 50% of max structure value.
Close the naked put alone if its delta reaches 0.20.
No rolling the naked leg down and out.
exit_rules: ASSIGNMENT GUARD: all short puts flat by 15:30 ET on expiration day.
Close any short put at extrinsic < $0.10 or |delta| >= 0.85.
Close the unit on a close below the naked strike.
assignment_risk: Two short puts, one uncovered; assignment delivers up to 200 shares, 100 of them unhedged.
buying_power: Naked put margin on 1 contract plus the debit spread cost, or strike x 100 cash if secured.
liquidity_needs: Same as the 112; the 0.05-0.10 delta strike must be closeable.
common_mistakes: Assuming half the naked puts means half the risk of ruin - the gap risk is the same shape, just smaller.
family: Completeness gap-fill (cross-family): ratio/naked-financed put and call structures, quantity-unbalanced condors and strangles, stock+option overlays and monetizations, capital-protection and hybrid builds, 0DTE four-leg income, volatility-surface and relative-value trades, event-driven overlays, and roll/adjustment structures
blocked_because: needs Alpaca options level 4; this account is level 3. Alpaca rejects it with 'account not eligible to trade uncovered option contracts'. Raising the level is an Alpaca approval, not a code change.
